data.name: AMEN: MAYHEM
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

WELCOME TO THE MAYHEM

Jump In and Play

No extra accounts or sign-ups are required.

Official servers are available in-game, so you can jump straight into a match with no additional setup. Just pick a room and start playing.

Fight monsters.

Fight alongside other players.

When the moment comes...

Fight each other.

Then claim whatever the dead leave behind.

AMEN: MAYHEM is a fast-paced top-down action game where up to 12 fighters clash across dark fantasy battlefields filled with devastating weapons, brutal pixel gore, chaotic physics, and complete disorder.

Sometimes victory belongs to the strongest.

Sometimes it belongs to whoever survives everyone else.

EVERY BATTLE FALLS APART

Order never lasts.

A sword fight becomes a magical explosion.

One shield charge destroys everyone's plan.

The fighter dominating the battlefield falls...

And someone else walks away with the armor.

Weapons constantly change hands.

Unexpected attacks come from every direction.

Someone always makes a terrible decision.

Plans survive...

Until the first explosion.

THE DEAD LEAVE EVERYTHING BEHIND

Defeated fighters drop their weapons and equipment.

Found something stronger?

Take it.

Lost everything?

Take it back.

Power never disappears.

It simply changes owners.

A single death can change the balance of an entire fight.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH UP TO 12 FIGHTERS

Fight through dangerous stages on your own, or jump into online multiplayer battles with up to 12 fighters.

Play with real people.

Add bots.

Or mix both together in the same match.

Sometimes you'll fight side by side.

Sometimes you'll be fighting over the same weapon seconds later.

Every battle can turn in an instant.

BOTS THAT ACTUALLY FIGHT BACK

Bots aren't just there to fill empty slots.

Intelligent AI fighters are designed to behave like real participants, reacting to the battlefield, competing for weapons and equipment, and making their own combat decisions.

They look for opportunities.

They know when to attack.

They know when to back off.

And they adapt when the battlefield suddenly changes.

This is a game built for those moments when you don't want to overthink anything.

Jump in.

Grab something dangerous.

Start a fight.

And blow off some steam.

Play a quick match with intelligent AI, or head online and fight actual people.

Mix both together if you want.

You don't need a full lobby to start the mayhem.

WEAPONS BUILT TO CAUSE PROBLEMS

Every weapon changes the fight.

Cut through enemies with oversized blades.

Crash into crowds with massive shields.

Rain destruction from above.

Detonate explosives.

Pilot heavy armor.

Wield strange magical weapons and divine artifacts capable of changing the entire battlefield.

Some weapons reward precision.

Others reward poor decisions.

Most reward absolute chaos.

And the arsenal won't stay still.

New weapons and tools are planned for future updates.

SHORT MATCHES. BIG DISASTERS.

Every match is easy to understand.

No match is easy to predict.

New weapons appear.

Power changes hands.

Strong fighters fall.

Someone else seizes the opportunity.

Win through skill.

Steal someone else's advantage.

Or simply survive everyone else's mistakes.

Then do it all again.

A WORLD CONSUMED BY WAR

At first, it seems like a simple mission.

Fight.

Survive.

Move on to the next battlefield.

But something feels wrong from the very beginning.

The weapons placed in your hands are far too dangerous for any one person to possess.

And here, that seems to be considered perfectly normal.

The fighting continues.

The scale of destruction keeps growing.

And no one talks about when the war will end.

The further you go, the more questions remain.

Why is this much power necessary?

And more importantly...

What exactly are you fighting for?

FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer battles with up to 12 fighters

  • Intelligent AI available in both single-player and multiplayer

  • Mix human players and AI fighters in the same multiplayer match

  • Loot weapons and equipment from defeated opponents

  • Brutal pixel gore, destruction, and satisfying combat

  • Swords, magic, explosives, shields, heavy armor, and divine artifacts

  • Free-for-All, Team Battle, Arena, and Elimination game modes

  • Fast, replayable matches designed for quick bursts of action

  • New weapons and tools planned for future updates

BLESS THIS MESS.

Grab a weapon.

Lose a friend.

AMEN.

data.short_description: A fast-paced top-down action game where up to 12 players slaughter enemies and each other with absurd weapons, brutal pixel gore, and chaotic physics. Fight solo or online, grab dropped gear, and discover new weapons and tools as the mayhem keeps growing.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.

content_descriptors.notes: AMEN: MAYHEM contains frequent stylized pixel-art violence, blood, and gore, including dismemberment, body parts, corpses, and explosions. Characters can kill one another using melee weapons, magic, and other destructive equipment. The game also features self-destructive equipment capable of killing the player's own character. Gore can be reduced or disabled in the game settings.
